children: Canton targets a transition to CIP-0104's network-traffic-based reward calculation in February 2027. The planned change includes a cap of $0.79 in app rewards for every $1 of attributed burn.

CC app rewards will follow measured network traffic, changing how rewards flow to applications on Canton. The calculation ties app rewards to traffic while attributed burn sets the maximum amount payable.

title: Canton: CIP-0104 targets traffic-based app rewards - Feb 2027
